role: Prime engine supplier: BE-4 oxygen-rich staged-combustion LOX/LNG engines power the ULA Vulcan first stage (and Blue Origin's own New Glenn); merchant engine sale to an outside integrator (ULA)

citation.quote: The BE-4 engines power the boosters of the Vulcan rocket... Each BE-4 can develop 550,000 pounds of thrust with liquid natural gas (LNG) and oxygen.

role: Prime upper-stage engine supplier: RL10 (RL10C / RL10C-X) cryogenic LOX/LH2 engines power ULA Vulcan Centaur upper stage, Atlas V, Delta IV, and NASA SLS; ULA placed a 116-engine order

citation.quote: Two RL10 engines power the upper stage of ULA's new Vulcan Centaur rocket.

role: In-house engine design and manufacture: Merlin (Falcon 9, RP-1/LOX) and Raptor (Starship, methane/LOX) are produced internally; SpaceX developed its own Merlin 1D turbopump, displacing the early external unit

citation.quote: The Raptor is a family of rocket engines developed and manufactured by SpaceX.

role: Turbopump supplier: built the RP-1/LOX turbopumps feeding early SpaceX Merlin engines on Falcon 9, and turbopumps for Virgin Orbit NewtonThree and Relativity Aeon-1; the dominant US merchant new-rocket-turbopump house

citation.quote: BNI has been working with SpaceX since 2002 and produced the turbopumps that supply kerosene (RP-1) and liquid oxygen (LOX) propellants to the Merlin engines.

role: Upstream valve/regulator supplier: solenoid valves, check valves, manifolds and pressure regulators on every Falcon 9 (tank pressurization, stage separation, landing-leg deployment, attitude control); supplied 50,000th CoRe valve to Rocket Lab in 2025

citation.quote: Marotta's technologies used in applications including tank pressurization, stage separation, landing leg deployment and attitude control comprise a substantial number of components which are on every Falcon 9 launch.

role: Upstream cryogenic/pneumatic valve supplier: latch valves, isolation valves, prevalves, regulators and filters for launch vehicle main propulsion systems; supplies the 12-inch cryogenic prevalve on the NASA SLS Core Stage

citation.quote: VACCO Industries is the premiere supplier of critical cryogenic and pneumatic space flight components to the U.S. manned space and expendable launch vehicle programs.

role: Aluminum-lithium mill-product supplier: low-density Airware 2195-T8 plate used in the tank barrels and domes of the Falcon 9 booster (also Al-Li for NASA SLS / Orion)

citation.quote: Low-density Airware 2195-T8 plate used in the tank barrels and domes of the booster is supplied by Constellium (formerly Alcan Global ATI).

role: In-house structural material: Starship/Super Heavy built from stainless steel; SpaceX moved from 301 to 304L to a proprietary in-house-developed 30X austenitic alloy. No external mill named in public sources

citation.quote: Musk said the 30X alloy, produced through SpaceX's research, development, and testing, is a "super material".

supplier_name: Titanium Metals Corp. (TIMET, a Precision Castparts / Berkshire Hathaway company)
role: Sole-source upstream constraint: the only domestic US producer of titanium sponge, the raw feedstock for aerospace titanium mill product, forgings and grid-fin stock; US is ~68% import-dependent for sponge

citation.quote: The only U.S. producer, Titanium Metals Corp. (known as "Timet")

role: Dominant upstream titanium mill-product / forgings supplier: vertically integrated Russian producer holding the largest share of the aerospace titanium market; a geopolitical chokepoint for titanium feedstock

citation.quote: VSMPO AVISMA holds approximately 25% of the aerospace titanium market, anchored in vertically integrated supply to leading aircraft manufacturers.

role: Upstream titanium mill-product and high-strength alloy supplier (ingot to finished mill product); one of the four producers comprising ~75-80% of aerospace titanium mill supply

citation.quote: Four suppliers comprise 75-80% of aerospace mill product supply: VSMPO-Avisma, Allegheny Technologies Inc. (ATI), TIMET and Howmet.

role: Upstream titanium/superalloy forgings and structural castings supplier; one of the four producers comprising ~75-80% of aerospace titanium mill supply

citation.quote: Four suppliers comprise 75-80% of aerospace mill product supply: VSMPO-Avisma, Allegheny Technologies Inc. (ATI), TIMET and Howmet.

supplier_name: Fiber Materials Inc. (FMI, a Spirit AeroSystems / now Boeing-affiliated company)
role: Upstream TPS precursor supplier: produces the carbon FiberForm rigid carbon-fiber preform that is infused with phenolic resin to make PICA (Phenolic-Impregnated Carbon Ablator) heat shields

citation.quote: Fiber Materials Inc. produces carbon FiberForm, a rigid, low density porous carbon foam-like material from chopped carbon fibers

role: TPS integrator: integrated the PICA heat shield for the Mars 2020 (Perseverance) entry vehicle in Denver, CO; representative carbon-phenolic ablator prime/integrator for entry systems

citation.quote: The Mars 2020 PICA heat shield protected the Perseverance rover and its descent stage, and was integrated at Lockheed Martin Space in Denver, Colorado.

role: In-house thermal protection: Starship's windward heat-shield tiles (ceramic, hexagonal) are developed and produced in-house; PICA-X ablator likewise SpaceX-developed from the licensed NASA PICA

citation.quote: SpaceX later worked with PICA's inventors at Ames Research Center to outfit its Dragon capsule, which is now delivering cargo to and from the International Space Station.

role: Rad-hard processor supplier: RAD750 (PowerPC) and RAD5500 radiation-hardened spaceborne microprocessors used in spacecraft/launch-vehicle avionics

citation.quote: The RAD750 is a radiation-hardened single-board computer manufactured by BAE Systems Electronics, Intelligence & Support.

role: Rad-tolerant FPGA supplier: RT PolarFire (28 nm) radiation-tolerant FPGA family for space/launch avionics

citation.quote: The Microchip RT PolarFire is a 28 nm device with 481k logic cells and up to 10.3125 Gbps data transmission.

role: Rad-tolerant FPGA supplier: RT Kintex UltraScale (20 nm) radiation-tolerant FPGA for high-throughput space/launch avionics

citation.quote: The Xilinx RT Kintex UltraScale, a 20 nm device, has 726 k logic cells and supports 12.5 Gbps serial data transmission.

role: Inertial measurement / navigation supplier: Miniature Inertial Measurement Unit (MIMU) and space-grade IMUs used to control and stabilize spacecraft and launch vehicles

citation.quote: Miniature inertial measurement unit (MIMU) is an inertial measurement unit (IMU) developed and built by Honeywell International to control and stabilize spacecraft during mission operations.

role: Inertial navigation supplier: space/launch and hypersonic-grade IMUs (e.g., LN-200 fiber-optic-gyro family and advanced hypersonic IMU flown on sounding rockets)

citation.quote: Northrop Grumman's Advanced Hypersonic Technology (AHT) Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) has successfully completed its third groundbreaking test, this time on a sounding rocket

role: Star-tracker supplier: Hydra multi-head APS star tracker providing spacecraft/launch-stage attitude determination

citation.quote: HYDRA is a new multi-head APS star tracker developed by SODERN.

role: Star-tracker supplier: T1 / T3 star trackers for attitude determination on satellites and space vehicles

citation.quote: Terma's T3 Star Tracker is a highly compact device offering precise tracking capabilities and outstanding thermal stability

role: Upstream interconnect supplier: space-grade connectors (Micro-D, Nano-D, 38999), hold-down release mechanisms, shielded cable and full harness assemblies for launch vehicles and upper stages; meets NASA/ESA/JAXA outgassing standards

citation.quote: From launch vehicles and upper stages to satellites, spacecraft, and mission payloads, Glenair delivers complete interconnect solutions engineered for the extreme demands of spaceflight.

role: Connector supplier: MIL-DTL-38999 (D38999) circular connectors qualified for spacecraft, satellites and rocket launchers

citation.quote: A space-grade variation, D38999, serves spacecraft, satellites, and rocket launchers.

role: Connector supplier: MIL-DTL-38999 / space-grade D38999 interconnects used across launch and spacecraft applications

citation.quote: Key players such as TE Connectivity, Amphenol Aerospace, and Glenair are actively enhancing their product offerings to capture larger market shares in the space-grade connectors market.

subsystem: recovery hardware (actuators / TVC / fin & leg control)
role: Upstream actuation supplier: electromechanical / electrohydraulic / electrohydrostatic actuators and thrust-vector-control systems for launch vehicles; flew the actuators steering ULA's Vulcan on its inaugural launch (also Antares, Centaur)

citation.quote: Moog has substantial history flying three actuation technologies - electromechanical, electrohydraulic and electrohydrostatic - for all stages of a rocket.

role: In-house recovery hardware: Falcon 9 Block 5 cast titanium grid fins and carbon-fiber/aluminum landing legs; Super Heavy uses welded stainless-steel grid fins mounted to the booster. Built in-house

citation.quote: With Falcon 9 Block 5, aluminum grid fins were phased out entirely in favor of larger titanium fins... for Starship's Super Heavy booster, SpaceX has moved to a different approach: SpaceX will build them out of welded steel.

role: Carbon-fiber prepreg supplier: HexTow carbon fiber (incl. IM11) for launch-vehicle and space structures; supplies composites for 100+ space and defense programs

citation.quote: From helicopters to defense aircraft to launch vehicles, Hexcel provides composites for more than 100 space and defense programs.

role: Upstream carbon-fiber supplier: dominant aerospace carbon fiber (e.g. T1100/T800 grades) and prepreg with broad spaceflight heritage used across Western space programs and launch structures

citation.quote: With an extensive spaceflight heritage spanning 30 years, it's no wonder the largest space programs rely on Toray.

role: Carbon-fiber supplier: aerospace/space-grade carbon fiber and intermediate materials (one of the three Japanese/US majors with Toray and Hexcel)

citation.quote: Syensqo (Belgium), Toray Industries, Inc. (Japan), Mitsubishi Chemical Group Corporation (Japan), and Hexcel Corporation (US) are leading players

role: Upstream COPV supplier: industry-leading designer/manufacturer of composite-overwrapped pressure vessels (helium/nitrogen pressurant tanks); partnered with Hexcel on a Type 4 COPV unveiled at CAMX 2025

citation.quote: Hexcel announced the debut of a Type 4 composite-overwrapped pressure vessel (COPV), engineered in collaboration with HyPerComp Engineering Inc. and built using Hexcel's high-performance HexTow IM11-R/12K carbon fiber.

role: Upstream COPV supplier: Type 3 composite-overwrapped pressure vessels with thin 6061 aluminum liners for high-pressure gas storage in space applications

citation.quote: Advanced Structural Technologies, Inc (AST) offers Type 3 COPVs featuring a thin and lightweight 6061 aluminum liner.

role: Dominant cryogenic-gas merchant supplier: liquid oxygen, liquid nitrogen and helium for launch operations; awarded the NASA LN2/LOX supply contract (~64,000 tons LOX) and supplies SpaceX cryogenics

citation.quote: Linde LLC will supply approximately 361,176 tons of liquid nitrogen and approximately 64,000 tons of liquid oxygen to support operations at the aforementioned NASA centers and facilities.

role: Helium and cryogenic-gas merchant supplier; also operates NASA Kennedy Space Center's on-site liquid-oxygen plant (up to 265 t/day). Part of the merchant gas layer that allocates scarce helium to aerospace

citation.quote: The key allocation decisions sit with the merchant gas layer (Linde, Air Liquide, Air Products, Messer, Iwatani), which controls distribution of scarce supply across fabs, hospitals, labs, and aerospace customers.

role: Cryogenic-gas merchant supplier: liquid hydrogen and helium for launch; won >$140M in NASA contracts to supply LH2 to Kennedy Space Center / Cape Canaveral; part of the helium merchant allocation layer

citation.quote: The key allocation decisions sit with the merchant gas layer (Linde, Air Liquide, Air Products, Messer, Iwatani), which controls distribution of scarce supply across fabs, hospitals, labs, and aerospace customers.

role: Upstream helium feedstock chokepoint: Qatar's Ras Laffan complex accounts for roughly one-third (~34%) of global helium production; its disruption drives launch-pressurant supply risk industry-wide

citation.quote: Qatar accounts for a third (34%) of global production.

role: Upstream propellant logistics: cryogenic-trailer transport of liquid methane (LNG) to SpaceX's Starbase launch site for Starship/Super Heavy Raptor fueling

citation.quote: SpaceX uses the transportation company GenOx to transport most of their liquid methane.

role: In-house composite structures: Neutron's tanks and major structures are the largest carbon-composite rocket structures, built in-house via Automated Fiber Placement at Rocket Lab's Space Structures Complex (Maryland)

citation.quote: Rocket Lab's AFP (Automated Fiber Placement) machine enables automated production of Neutron structures and tanks - the largest carbon composite rocket structures in history.
